name: Ranged Web Requests (demo)
description: You are in a location where the Wi-Fi or cellular signal is weak. You try to load a webpage. The loading seems to start, but it takes a long time and stops halfway through. It's evident that the same issue occurs with images as well. You refresh the page, but since the previously loaded part wasn't cached, you have to start all over again. Frustrating, isn't it? This extension serves as a demonstration of how such an issue can be resolved.
